title: Dispatch World3d Camera And Shell Commands To Command History
description: Wire the aggregator app's 3D-viewport camera gestures (World3dHost) into a debounced 'setCamera'/'setProjection' plugin dispatch carrying windowId, guard the scene-camera reattach against self-echo, and add a noteShellCommand telemetry helper in the main React OS shell wired into os-command dispatch, direct theme/appearance/locale/driver/layout setters, dock-tab drag-drop, window resize/rearrange, window activate/close/split, and panel visibility/tab-path/hotkey toggles - so the plugin-side command-history panel (landing separately in Rust) has something to show for 3D camera and shell-chrome interactions, which today leave it empty.
summary: Wired World3dHost's user-driven camera gestures (orbit/pan/zoom end via WorldOrbitGated, gizmo snap via WorldOrbitViewControls) into a debounced 'setCamera' plugin dispatch carrying windowId and position/target/zoom/up (never 'projection', which would fail Rust deserialization), split the auto-fit-to-content path off into its own non-dispatching handler, added a 'setProjection' dispatch to the projection-kind-switch handler, and extended shouldReattachWorldViewportCamera with an epsilon-based self-echo guard so the plugin echoing back this component's own just-dispatched camera never visually snaps the viewport. Added a noteShellCommand telemetry helper in the main OS shell (FrameworkOsShell) routed through the existing onAction funnel, wired it into the os-command dispatcher, the direct theme/appearance/locale/terminology/driver/layout setters that bypass it, dock-tab/tree-unit drag-drop, window activate/close/split, a settled window-resize-vs-rearrange classifier, panel visibility/tab-path toggles, and the panel-chrome hotkey toggle; extracted the tutorial-recording exclusion set into an exported constant and added 'noteShellCommand' to it. Added a no-op guard on TiledMapHost's boot-time camera mirror so opening the app doesn't log a phantom Set Camera row. Added new locale-schema entries (en/de) for the new shell-chrome command labels in the ui-react package. All new pure helpers (buildWorldCameraDispatchArgs, worldCameraPoseApproxEqual, shouldReattachWorldViewportCamera's new param, classifyWindowLayoutChange, buildNoteShellCommandAction) got unit tests in the sibling test file. Full nx-orchestrated test suite could not be confirmed to finish within the session (~20+ min) due to extreme concurrent load in this shared repo (400+ competing nx invocations observed via ps) and a pre-existing missing WASM build artifact (@semio-tech/framework-surface-paint-rs/pkg) blocking a direct vitest run; the sibling ui-react package's typecheck target was run successfully and showed zero new errors near any of my edits (only pre-existing, unrelated errors elsewhere in that file).
